title: How to Freeze Your Credit for Free in Under 10 Minutes
bigPicture: Freezing your credit blocks thieves from opening new accounts in your name.
whatYouNeedToKnow: It costs nothing to freeze or unfreeze your credit.
Only you can lift the freeze when you want to apply for credit.
You must freeze your credit at all three major bureaus.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Paying a fee to freeze your credit (it’s free by law).
Freezing just one bureau (you need all three).
actionSteps: Go to the website of a credit bureau (Equifax, Experian, or TransUnion).
Click ‘freeze credit’ and write down the PIN they give you.
